repair_contract.demand_ordering: Retain runtime_sink(True) before awaited warmup, because existing managed preparation demand is derived from that effective flag or Peer intent.
repair_contract.current_generation_failure: Current-generation enabled warmup failure or cancellation publishes effective False and dashboard False, then re-raises the original exception unchanged.
repair_contract.post_await_fence: A successful warmup result is accepted only for the original generation and enabled intent. There is no new True publication after the await.
repair_contract.late_failure: An old failure cannot disable a newer pending or successful enable or clear that newer generation's starting projection.
repair_contract.disable_and_exhaustion: Newer disable or managed exhaustion publishes off and fences old completion and failure.
repair_contract.stop_ingress: Preserve the existing no-publication semantics. It fences old completion and failure without late success, True, or starting publication. It does not itself promise runtime configuration off; shutdown owns drain and teardown.
repair_contract.readiness: translation_runtime_ready intentionally means provider attachment, not successful native initialization. A disabled lazy provider may remain binding-ready while models.status retains native preparation failure.
unchanged_mechanisms: No alternate model or CPU/cloud fallback
No inference or performance mechanism changes
